title: ever EMILIA|Glitter A-Line Maxi Evening Dress with Chiffon
descriptionHtml:
This elegant chiffon gown features a shimmering sequin top paired with a soft, flowing skirt that flatters every figure. The 3/4 sleeves provide graceful coverage, while the cinched waistband defines your shape. Ideal for formal weddings, evening events, and sophisticated celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: 3/4 sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
